meta.title: Covelet · A private start page you can verify, that doesn’t go soft
hero.h1: A private start page you can verify, that doesn’t go soft
hero.tagline: No account · Encrypted on device · Data stays in storage you control
hero.lead: Covelet is a Chrome / Edge new-tab extension. Nav and notes stay on your device with AES. Across devices, sync to your own WebDAV (Nutstore or Nextcloud). There is no Covelet product server, and we don’t proxy ciphertext.
points.no_account: No account to create. We don’t proxy OAuth either.
points.local_aes: Nav and notes are encrypted on device. You can check permissions and where data lives in the extension.
points.own_storage: Real cloud sync today is WebDAV (Nutstore / Nextcloud). R2, OSS, GitHub, GitLab, and the rest are still Beta. We don’t claim “all five work,” and we don’t claim rock-solid multi-device switching.
points.no_telemetry: No ads, no third-party analytics, no usage stats.
verify.body: This site is a static page. It doesn’t handle your data, upload nav or notes, or load PostHog or tracking pixels. In the extension you can check permissions and data location (“Privacy check-up,” from 0.3). Match these claims against the product and this site.
site_wont.body: No login, no email capture, no tracking pixels, and no ads on your start page. The page only explains the product and links to the store.
storage.intro: The first real cloud channel is WebDAV (Nutstore / Nextcloud). Other channels are Beta for now.
storage.step1: Prefer WebDAV (Nutstore / Nextcloud). The rest are Beta.
storage.step2: Enter only what the connection needs, then test it.
storage.step3_title: Set a sync password and sync once
storage.step3: Other devices use the same target and sync password.
storage.note: Saving is not the same as verified. Trust a successful connection test. If the test fails, you can stay local-only; local data is untouched. On multi-device conflicts we choose one whole record or the other. We don’t silent-merge, and you see which copy you picked.
migrate.disclaimer: Read these literally. Don’t treat them as shipped features.
migrate.bookmarks: Available now. Runs on device; works with bookmark files exported from the browser.
migrate.others: Migration paths are still under review.
close.h2: Keep the new tab for yourself
close.body: No preset promo sites. After install you start from an empty desktop and add the sites you use.
